verdict.rationale: Nitrokey has an official, documented CLI (nitropy). A runtime probe shows it installs from PyPI and describes itself as a 'Command line tool to interact with Nitrokey devices', so the core of the story is the product's own capability. The pack does not document which operations it supports (enabling applications, setting PINs, managing slots, reading device state) or whether it is scriptable, so its depth is unproven. missing for 10: documented subcommands for enabling/disabling applications, PIN setting/changing, slot management, device-state/status readout, evidence of scriptable/non-interactive output, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure and manage the key from an official CLI — enable applications, set PINs, manage slots, read device state — scriptably

citations.quote: Command line tool to interact with Nitrokey devices
